about: Fake scenarios for run_scenarios.py. Every person, address and event is made up. Unless a scenario says otherwise: now is Mon Nov 9, 2026 10:00 AM in New York, the user is Sam Rivera (America/New_York), and the calendar is the 'typical' week below, checked for 14 days. 'expect' lists what a good answer looks like; the runner also re-checks every time in the answer with slots.check_time, independently of the pipeline.
